settings.mission: Our mission is to share the most comforting and nostalgic Filipino food. We source only high quality ingredients locally through other small businesses and farmers in BC to prepare and cook with love.

settings.text: PRO-TIP: ask us for crispy fried wok eggs

settings.image_alt: Silog feast: garlic fried rice topped with fried eggs, with tapa, longganisa and fried bangus
settings.heading: Silogs, better throughout the day
settings.text: Silogs are the staple to Filipino breakfast. But better throughout the day. Very comforting, tastes nostalgic, and feels like home. We fry our signature garlic fried rice in a wok for added smokiness and aroma. Paired with your choice of grilled meats, fried fish, or roasted eggplant. Topped with an egg, fresh green onions, and in-house made garlic bits.
Toyomansi: Soy sauce and calamansi dipping sauce for the Inihaw Feasts. Pour it all over your rice too!

settings.image_alt: Trays of charcoal-grilled chicken inasal, pork belly and BBQ pork skewers on banana leaves with calamansi
settings.heading: Fresh off the grill and fire
settings.text: Filipino authentic grilled meats served over our signature garlic fried rice. “The Skewers” are tender pork marinated in a sweet and savoury Filipino bbq sauce. “Chicken Inasal” is boneless chicken legs (thighs and drumsticks) marinated in soy, garlic, ginger, lemongrass grilled over charcoal.
